data.desc: Genenta Science (Nasdaq: GNTA) is evolving into a next-generation strategic consolidator focused on privately held specialized companies operating in Italian national security-regulated sectors, with activities spanning cybersecurity, defense, aerospace, and biotechnology/biosecurity. Genenta holds a 19% equity interest in Sòphia High Tech and has an option to increase its ownership to 51% at a pre-agreed valuation.
